ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account flag — the driver remained within 200 m of the pickup (33–38 m) throughout and never tapped "I'm Here", so the abuse-of-button pattern in NS-2 is not made out.

rejected_claims.reason: Physical presence is not contested and is supported by GPS [F1][F2][F3], but presence alone satisfies only NS-1 (ii); NS-1 is conjunctive and element (i) fails because no 'I'm Here' tap was ever recorded [F6][NS-1], so D1 cannot establish the fee.
The wait element NS-1 (iii) may be met on GPS (5 min 20 s within 200 m, 4 min 0 s stationary) [F2][F3][F5], but a long wait cannot cure the missing arrival tap [F6][NS-1].

The absence of a rider chat message says nothing about the rider's whereabouts; the complete record contains only two one-way driver messages with no request for the rider to come out [F9][F10][F11]. 'Not seen in chat' is not proof of no-show under NS-1, and the fee already falls on the failed tap [F6][NS-1].

The clean profile [F17] does not defeat the refund required by NS-2 on the failed NS-1 (i) element [F6][F12][NS-2]; it is relevant only in that it supports not adding a fraud flag, which is not needed to decide the refund.
